plugins.description: Thirteen Claude skills for day trading: a chart scanner, a news monitor, an entry timer, an exit planner, a time machine that replays 10,000 sessions, a risk manager, a budget manager, an order executor (paper by default, never without your yes), a trading bot that runs the opening-range breakout on its own (paper by default, live only when you arm it), price alerts, an earnings analyst, a Pelosi tracker and ten learning modules with quizzes.
